To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the financial health of an agricultural holding can be assessed by the gurck index, in99 index, oP index, chrastinova indicator and in95 indicator, but that the predicative ability of the indices is very limited.
the prediction of the development of a holding by financial health indicators is possible only in the inter-enterprises and time comparison.
it is impossible to find an indicator which can be used to predict the development of a company.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: the limited predicative ability and the non-standardized character of financial health indicators, the conditional efficiency of some of the indicators for the prediction of a holding’s development and the possibilities of their use for the prediction of potential dangers and risks.
the possibilities of using individual financial indicators in the prediction of the development of agricultural enterprises.
the possibilities to predict the future development of agricultural holdings using financial indicators of financial health.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
financial health indicators are not suitable for prediction of future developments.
it is not possible to predict the future development of agricultural holdings by means of financial health indicators.
the prediction of future development and the risk assessment of an agricultural company are not easy and cannot be achieved by the simple use of a single financial index.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the prediction of the future development of agricultural holdings is not possible with the current indicators.
it is not possible to predict the future development of agricultural holdings by means of financial indices only.

it is not possible to predict a future value of an agricultural holding by the use of individual indicators, but the inter-enterprise comparison of individual indicators can help in the identification of the most successful holdings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the financial health indices are useful for the comparison of holdings and their inter-temporal comparison but they are not suitable for the prediction of a holding’s future development.
the use of financial health indicators in agriculture should be based on a detailed analysis of the individual index and its applicability to a particular holding and a particular type of danger.

it is not the financial indicators that should be used for the prediction of a future development of agricultural holdings but rather the indicators which describe the production specialization of the holdings.
